integrity: All theorem statements are proved analytically. The symbolic artifact checks only algebraic reductions and is not used as a substitute for the invariant-measure proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the displayed classical dissipative Zaslavsky normalization with r, nu, epsilon positive and to compactly supported invariant probabilities. It does not prove existence, uniqueness, mixing, a central limit theorem, a diffusion coefficient, or realization of interior drift values. Full-text comparison of the 2008 transport article was unavailable, leaving a recorded residual overlap risk.
title: Sharp stationary transport strip for the Zaslavsky map
